title: LinkedIn Jobs Scraper
description: Scrape LinkedIn job listings via guest (no-login) endpoints. Configure search terms, filters, detail scraping, and anti-blocking/resilience options below.

searchQueries.title: Search queries
searchQueries.description: Job search keywords. One search is run per query.

location.title: Location
location.description: Location filter applied to all search queries (e.g. "United States", "San Francisco", "Remote").

startUrls.title: Start URLs (advanced)
startUrls.description: Optional: provide LinkedIn job search URLs directly instead of generating them from searchQueries/location/filters. If set, searchQueries and the filter options below are ignored.

maxItems.title: Max items
maxItems.description: Maximum number of jobs to scrape across all search queries.

datePosted.title: Date posted
datePosted.description: Filter jobs by how recently they were posted.

scrapeJobDetails.title: Scrape job details
scrapeJobDetails.description: Visit each job's detail page to extract the full description, seniority level, employment type, skills, and applicant count. Slower and uses more requests.

scrapeCompanyDetails.title: Scrape company details
scrapeCompanyDetails.description: Visit each unique company's "about" page to extract industry and company size. Adds one extra request per unique company.

outputFields.title: Output fields (advanced)
outputFields.description: Restrict each pushed record to only these field names, to reduce dataset size. Leave empty to keep all fields. ID fields (jobId, companyId, type) are always kept.

errorRateThreshold.title: Error rate threshold
errorRateThreshold.description: If the rolling fraction of blocked/failed requests exceeds this value (after at least 10 requests), the actor automatically halves its concurrency and, if configured, sends a webhook alert.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Recommended: use Apify residential proxies for best success rates against LinkedIn's anti-bot protection.

resumeFromPreviousRun.title: Resume from previous run
resumeFromPreviousRun.description: Skip jobs and companies already scraped in a prior run of this actor (tracked via the key-value store), so a scheduled/recurring run only scrapes what's new.
resumeFromPreviousRun.sectionDescription: Optional webhook notifications sent by the actor itself, separate from Apify platform webhooks.

webhookUrl.title: Webhook URL
webhookUrl.description: URL to POST JSON events to: HIGH_ERROR_RATE (when errorRateThreshold is exceeded) and, if enabled below, COMPLETED.

notifyOnCompletion.title: Notify on completion
notifyOnCompletion.description: Send a COMPLETED webhook event (to webhookUrl) with a run summary when scraping finishes.
